records.text: Sleep quality and duration, nutrition, stress, illness, work/school demands and training load all influence recovery.
Muscle soreness is not a reliable score of workout quality. A productive session can cause little soreness; severe or persistent pain is not a badge of honour.
Use performance trends, readiness, motivation, soreness, sleep and session completion together; no single wearable metric should decide training.
Overreaching is a short-term fatigue state that may be planned or unplanned; overtraining syndrome is a serious, prolonged maladaptation and should not be casually self-diagnosed.
Active recovery can be low-intensity movement that feels restorative; it is optional, not mandatory.
